test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Out of the four sentences given, three have spelling errors. Identify the sentence that has no spelling error.

options.text: What advice did he give to young entrepreneurs?
She tried to manuvre her trolley around people.
The computer’s software detected an anamoly caused by a virus.
A clergyman read the litugry from the prayer-book.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Option 1: "Entrepreneur" refers to a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit. (उद्यमी)

 
 
• Example: She is a young entrepreneur who started her own tech company.
 
 
 
• There is no error in **'What advice did he give to young entrepreneurs?' **

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences.

 
• Option 2: "manuvre" (निपुणता से काम करना): The correct spelling is "manoeuvre". It refers to skillful movement in a situation.

 
 
• Example: The driver had to manoeuvre around the traffic jam to reach his destination quickly.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "anamoly"** (असामान्यता): The correct spelling is "anomaly," which means something that deviates from what is normal or expected.
 
 
• **Example:** The report showed an anomaly in the financial figures.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "litugry"** (धार्मिक अनुष्ठान): The correct spelling is "liturgy," which refers to the prescribed form of worship in certain Christian traditions.
 
 
• **Example:** The liturgy at the cathedral was beautifully performed by the choir.
